alignmentNotes: hero (full-bleed bg image + left h1, white text) and hero-split (left/right) are not centered; use hero-split for leads and keep text-light. cards/columns default left; keep copy short. Never restyle reused blocks.

hero-split.fingerprint: 1 row x 2 cells: text (eyebrow/h1/p/CTA links) + media

cards.fingerprint: N rows x 2 cells: image cell + body cell (h3,p,link)

cards-features.fingerprint: N rows x 1 cell: bold title + description + optional link; 3 or 4 multiples, ticks auto

columns.fingerprint: N rows x 2 cells: text + picture

columns-offer.fingerprint: 1 row x 2 cells: text+CTAs | offer card (label, price stat, note, tick list)

table-comparison.fingerprint: header row + N rows x (1 label cell + K value cells); values Included/Excluded become icons; 2 paragraphs in value cell = value+note

accordion-faq.fingerprint: N rows x 2 cells: question + answer

budget: columns-offer best-value -> cards -> table-comparison price breakdown -> CTA

notes: Site content is mostly boilerplate (live pages only hero/columns/cards); fingerprints for custom blocks are from block JS + READMEs, not live pages. Reuse covers all shapes; no new blocks.
